title: Student V0.1 JOB 07 — pilot packaging and learner-start UX
purpose: Create the smallest deterministic, local/offline pilot package and learner-start flow around the exact qualified application, independent of the final showcase content.
invariants: The pilot layer wraps exact qualified application bytes; it does not fork or patch product semantics.
The packaging contract is generic with respect to the final V4 kit and must not consume JOB06 output.
Output is deterministic and local/offline; no backend, remote catalog or network dependency.
Learner-start friction is measured, not hidden.
Canonical kit scoring secrets may exist in the local package artifact, but the UI presentation boundary must not leak them; do not claim file-level secrecy.
A real served V4 journey failure is reported as a product boundary HOLD, not repaired from packaging scope.
requiredEvidence: Deterministic package builder or equivalent reproducible packaging mechanism.
Manifest binding exact app artifact and input kit hashes.
No remote resources or network requirements.
Clear learner/facilitator start instructions with measured action count.
Import/start/reload/resume/finish probe using an independently generated valid rich V4 fixture, without JOB06 dependency.
Failure classification if the real application cannot complete the rich journey.
Package build repeated twice with identical bytes/hash.
adversarialTests: A package that only demonstrates qcm/fill cannot claim Student V0.1 rich-journey readiness.
A wrapper that embeds a modified app artifact is a scope failure.
A non-deterministic ZIP/timestamp or unbound kit/app pair is a packaging failure.
A start guide that requires undocumented developer knowledge is a learner-start failure.
A mobile path that cannot import/start or resume is a HOLD, not a desktop-only PASS.
No auto-import hack may bypass browser security or mutate core application code.
nonGoals: Repairing the learner runtime or presentation stack.
independentReview: The package must be testable with any valid V4 candidate, not only one hard-coded kit.
The worker must report actual start friction and not optimize the metric by skipping required learner actions.
The full served-browser smoke is the authority for pilot feasibility.
rollback: Close the JOB07 PR and delete its branch; qualified product bytes and sibling branches remain unchanged.
